assumptions: Feature names and numerical values are preserved without recomputation or rescaling; all 681 rows have the same 155 finite numeric features.
Feature names are lexicographically sorted in feature_names; use that order when constructing an array.
Original record order, campaign labels, ordinals, and binary labels are preserved.
The family field is the original historical campaign label, not a public proof-family identifier. In particular kaggle22_cross_output must not be identified with trinomial22.
Old bounded UNKNOWN depends on the original proof-search algorithm and budget. It is not an intrinsic group property, a probability of torsion-freeness, or a valid positive torsion-free label.
Chronological and campaign distribution differences matter for evaluation. This table alone establishes no transfer performance on another family.
Source paths and all metadata other than the listed fields were removed. Provenance retains only the original byte hash, without an input path.
The public_table_sha256 hashes the entire public file, including its final newline. No trained model or executable serialized object is included.
label_description: old_bounded_unknown is the historical binary label from the original bounded proof search: 1 means that run was recorded as UNRESOLVED_BOUNDED_SEARCH; 0 means it was not. UNKNOWN is not a torsion-free certificate. Labels are retained unchanged, even if later searches resolved a case. No positive torsion-free labels are present.
matching_sha256_definition: The final 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters of the legacy fingerprint. SHA256 of compact JSON encoding of the lexicographically sorted matching edges, with the two cells of each edge sorted. Does not bind affine images or campaign identity.
